Estimate sample sizes from standard deviation quantiles

Source: R/prolfqua-deprecated.R
lfq_power_t_test_quantiles.Rd

Estimate sample sizes from standard deviation quantiles

Usage

lfq_power_t_test_quantiles(
  quantile_sd,
  delta = c(0.59, 1, 2),
  power = 0.8,
  sig.level = 0.05,
  min.n = 1.5
)

Arguments

quantile_sd

output of summarize_stats_quantiles

delta

effect size you are interested in

power

of test

sig.level

P-Value

min.n

smallest n to determine

Value

a tibble with the rows of quantile_sd repeated for each delta, with the added columns sdtrimmed (the sd floored at the smallest sd resolvable with min.n samples), N_exact, N (rounded up) and delta

Note

Deprecated in prolfqua 1.9.5; use LFQData$get_Stats()$power_t_test_quantiles(). See prolfqua-deprecated.
